DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお持ちになりましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道で鍵を拾いました。青い輪に三本付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 青い輪に三本付いた鍵を拾ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found keys in the street, three on a blue ring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you found three keys on a blue ring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。拾った場所と時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. Tell me where and when you found them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅前の横断歩道のそばです。今日の午前十一時ごろに拾いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駅前の横断歩道付近と発見時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Near the pedestrian crossing outside the station. Around eleven this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the station crossing location and discovery time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの地図では、この横断歩道でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: On this map, is it this crossing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、その横断歩道です。駅から見て右側の歩道に落ちていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図の場所を確認し、駅から見た歩道の左右を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. They were on the pavement on the right when looking from the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the mapped location and explain right or left from the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所を記録しました。拾った後、どこかへ連絡されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I recorded the place. Did you contact anyone after finding them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、誰にも連絡せず、ここへ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 誰にも連絡せず署へ持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I contacted nobody and brought them here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you brought them to the police station without contacting anyone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 鍵をお預かりしました。こちらが受理番号を書いた控えです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have taken the keys. Here is a receipt with the acceptance number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。この番号は、後で問い合わせるときに使えばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受理番号が後日の問い合わせに使う番号か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Is this the number I should use for later enquiries?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask whether the acceptance number is for later enquiries. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お問い合わせの際にお伝えください。お届けいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, quote it when enquiring. Thank you for handing them in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。こちらは郵送する書類でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are these documents for posting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、折らずに送りたいのですが、持ってきた封筒に入りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 書類を折らずに送りたいが手持ちの封筒に入らないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to send them without folding, but they do not fit the envelope I brought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you want to send unfolded documents that do not fit your envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: A4が入る大きな封筒があります。普通の紙と、厚めの紙の二種類です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have large A4 envelopes, in regular or thicker paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 書類が十枚あるので、厚めのほうを一枚ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十枚の書類用に厚めの封筒を一枚注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are ten document sheets, so please give me one thicker envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Order one thick envelope for ten sheets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 厚めの封筒は八十円です。宛名を書く台はあちらにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The thicker envelope costs eighty yen. The addressing desk is over there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 八十円を払います。宛名を書いて書類を入れてから、ここに戻ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 封筒代を払い、宛名と中身を準備して戻る手順を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will pay eighty. Should I write the address, put the documents in and then come back here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Pay for the envelope and confirm preparing the address and contents before returning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、その状態でお持ちください。封をする前に、入れ忘れがないかもお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Check that nothing is left out before sealing it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 宛名を書いて、十枚全部入れました。これで重さを量ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宛名記入と十枚の封入を報告し、計量を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I wrote the address and put in all ten sheets. Could you weigh it now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the address and ten sheets enclosed, and request weighing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、この重さなら送料は二百円です。封をしてからお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, postage at this weight is two hundred yen. We will accept it after you seal it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 封をしました。送料の二百円はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封をしたと伝え、送料二百円を渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I sealed it. Here is two hundred yen postage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say it is sealed and hand over two hundred yen postage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二百円お預かりします。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Two hundred yen received. Thank you for using our service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座の確認ができました。今日は通帳の繰り越しですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: The account is confirmed. Today you are replacing a full bankbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、最後の行まで印字されています。新しい通帳に替えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記入欄が満杯になった通帳を新しいものに替えるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It is printed through the final line. Please replace it with a new one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to replace a bankbook whose entry space is full. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しい通帳をお作りします。古い通帳もお返ししますので、そのままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will make a new one and return the old one too. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 古いほうは、後から入出金を見返すために残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 過去の入出金を見返すため旧通帳を保管したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to keep the old one to review deposits and withdrawals later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the old bankbook for past transaction reviews. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お手元で保管できます。こちらが新しい通帳で、最初のページに前の残高が載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You may keep it. Here is the new book; the first page shows the previous balance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この金額が、古い通帳の最後の金額と同じですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新通帳の残高が旧通帳の最後の金額と一致すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: This amount matches the last amount in the old book, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the new book balance matches the old book's final amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、同じ残高を引き継いでいます。今後の記帳は新しいほうをご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, the same balance is carried forward. Use the new one for future updates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表紙が似ているので、古いほうに印を付けてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見分けるために旧通帳へ印を付けてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The covers look alike. May I mark the old one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to mark the old book to distinguish them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 古い通帳の表紙に印を付けていただいて構いません。新しいほうの機械で読む部分には貼らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may mark the old cover. Do not stick anything on the machine-readable area of the new one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古いほうの表紙にだけ印を付けます。二冊とも持ち帰りますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧通帳の表紙だけに印を付け、二冊を持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will mark only the old cover. I will take both books home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will mark only the old cover and take both home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、二冊お返しします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, here are both books back. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 洗剤をお探しですか。何かご不明な点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Looking for detergent? Is anything unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この袋の値段は三百六十円ですか。棚の値札と容量が違うようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋と値札の容量が違うようだと伝え、三百六十円か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Does this pouch cost three hundred and sixty yen? The volume seems different from the shelf label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say pouch and label volumes seem different and ask if it is three hundred and sixty yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋は四百ミリですが、値札は八百ミリ用ですね。小さい袋が違う棚に入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The pouch is four hundred millilitres, but the label is for eight hundred. A small pouch is on the wrong shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 四百ミリのほうは、いくらになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 四百ミリの袋の価格を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: How much is the four-hundred-millilitre one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the four-hundred-millilitre pouch price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 四百ミリは二百円です。正しい値札はこちらの下の棚にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Two hundred yen. The correct label is on the lower shelf here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きい袋も同じ洗剤ですか。香りが違うものは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大きい袋が同じ香りの洗剤か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is the larger pouch the same detergent? I want to avoid a different fragrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the large pouch has the same detergent fragrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じ香りの詰め替え用です。大きいほうは、こちらの八百ミリの袋になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is a same-fragrance refill. The larger one is this eight-hundred-millilitre pouch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二回詰め替えられる量が欲しいので、八百ミリのほうを一袋買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 四百ミリの本体に二回詰め替えるため八百ミリを一袋選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want enough for two refills, so I will buy one eight-hundred-millilitre pouch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose one eight-hundred-millilitre pouch for two refills of the four-hundred-millilitre bottle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、この袋をどうぞ。開けた後は口を閉じて保管できるタイプです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here it is. This type can be closed for storage after opening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 八百ミリで三百六十円ですね。この袋をレジに持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容量と価格を確認し、選んだ袋をレジへ持っていくと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Eight hundred millilitres for three hundred and sixty yen. I will take it to the checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check volume and price and say you will take the chosen pouch to the checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その袋で合っています。お買い物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, that is the correct pouch. Enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。芝生広場の通路は、今は工事で通れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. The lawn square path is closed for construction now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 池のそばのベンチへ行きたいです。この入口からは行けませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 池のベンチへ行きたいと伝え、閉じた入口から行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to reach the bench by the pond. Can I not go through this entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want the pond bench and ask about the closed entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この入口は閉めていますが、外周の舗装路を右へ進めば行けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This entrance is closed, but turn right along the paved outer path to get there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右の道ですね。曲がる場所の目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右へ行くと確認し、曲がる場所の目印を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The path on the right. Is there a landmark where I turn?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm right and ask a landmark for the turn. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 赤い水飲み場を過ぎると、池へ下りる分かれ道があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: After the red drinking fountain, there is a fork down to the pond.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水飲み場の先で曲がるのですね。ベンチは坂の下ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水飲み場の先で曲がると確認し、ベンチが坂の下か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Turn after the fountain. Is the bench at the bottom of the slope?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm turning after the fountain and ask if the bench is below the slope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、緩い坂を下りた先です。途中にも一つベンチがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, after a gentle descent. There is another bench on the way too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰りは池の反対側から回って来られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰りは池の反対側を回れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Can I return around the other side of the pond?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the return can go around the pond's other side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 反対側も工事の柵で行き止まりです。今日は来た道を戻ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That side also ends at construction fencing. Return by the same route today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。池のベンチで休んでから、同じ道を戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 池のベンチで休んで同じ道を戻る予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. After resting at the pond bench, I will take the same path back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will rest at the bench and return the same way. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、足元にお気をつけて。ごゆっくりどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Watch your step and take your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの経路について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about this itinerary?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が送ってくれた経路です。この乗り換えが二分しかなくて、間に合うか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二分の乗り換えに不安があると経路を示して相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend sent it. This transfer is only two minutes, so I worry whether I can make it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the route and discuss concern about a two-minute transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗り換えでは向かいのホームへ移りますが、初めてなら一本早い列車で出ると余裕があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You move to the opposite platform, but if it is your first time, one earlier train gives more time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一本早い列車は、何時に出ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一本早い列車の時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: When does the earlier train leave?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the earlier train time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 十三時十分です。乗り換え駅では十二分ほど時間があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thirteen ten. You have about twelve minutes at the transfer station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それにします。友人の駅に着く時間も早くなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 早い列車を選び目的駅の到着時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will choose that. Will I arrive at my friend's station earlier too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the early train and ask the destination arrival time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗り換えた後は同じ列車なので、到着は十四時二十分のままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: After transferring it is the same train, so arrival stays fourteen twenty.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。乗り換え先の列車は、どの表示を見ればわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗り換える列車の表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Which display identifies the train I transfer to?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the display for the connecting train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 青葉駅行きの普通列車です。快速には乗らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: A local train for Aoba Station. Do not take the rapid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十三時十分に出て、乗り換えでは青葉駅行きの普通を選びます。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出発時刻と乗り換える普通列車を言い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I leave thirteen ten and transfer to the Aoba local. Thank you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Restate departure and the local train to transfer to. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その経路です。お気をつけて行ってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, that is the route. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の申請ですね。提出先の案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: A certificate application. Do you have the recipient's instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 賃貸契約のために、住民票の写しが必要です。この案内を持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 賃貸契約用の住民票が必要と伝え提出案内を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need a copy of my residence record for a rental contract. I brought this guide.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you need a rental residence record and show the submission instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人だけのものを一通とありますね。今はお一人の世帯ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: It says one copy for yourself only. Are you a one-person household now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、弟と同じ世帯です。弟の分も載せる必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 弟と同一世帯と説明し弟の情報も必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I am in the same household as my younger brother. Does his information need including too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the shared household with your younger brother and ask about including him. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この案内の指定はご本人だけですので、申請書では「一部」を選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: These instructions specify yourself only, so select “part of household” on the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一部ですね。「続柄」という欄は、何を表しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一部を選ぶと確認して続柄の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Part of household. What does “relationship” mean?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm selecting part of household and ask what relationship means. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 世帯主との関係を表す項目です。提出先の案内では、その記載は不要となっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Relationship to the household head. These instructions say that field is unnecessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、続柄は載せないようにします。住所は、今の香芝市の住所でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 続柄を省く希望と現在の住所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will omit it. Please use my current Kashiba City address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request omission of relationship and give your current address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、申請書の住所欄にお書きください。本人確認書類も拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Write it in the address field. Let me also see your identification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この免許証です。本人だけの住民票を一通、続柄なしで申請します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人確認書類を示して申請内容を言い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: This driving licence. I am applying for one record for myself only, without relationship.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show identification and restate the application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 申請書と書類をお預かりします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take the form and documents. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の「痛み方」の欄が空いていますね。書きにくいところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: The pain-description field is blank. Is anything difficult to write?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「しびれる」と「ずきずきする」の違いが、よくわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 問診票の二つの痛みの表現の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not really understand “numb” versus “throbbing”.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the difference between the questionnaire's two pain descriptions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: しびれは、感覚が鈍くなったり、ぴりぴり感じたりすることです。言葉を選びにくければ、ご自身の感じ方で書いて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Numbness is reduced sensation or tingling. If choosing words is difficult, describe how it feels to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 感覚はありますが、右ひざが脈に合わせるように痛みます。これは、ずきずきで伝わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 感覚と右ひざの痛み方を具体的に説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have sensation, but my right knee hurts as though in time with my pulse. Does “throbbing” convey that?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe sensation and right-knee pain specifically. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、その説明をそのまま書いてください。いつから痛みがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, write that explanation. When did it begin?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三日前からです。座っているときより、階段を下りるときに強くなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 痛みの開始時期と強くなる動作を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Three days ago. It is stronger going down stairs than sitting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give onset and the movement that increases pain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 時期と、階段で強くなることも記録します。痛みは右ひざだけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record the time and worsening on stairs. Only your right knee?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 右ひざだけです。先生には、少しゆっくり説明していただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 痛む範囲を答え医師の説明の速さを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only the right. I would like the doctor to explain a little slowly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer the pain area and request the doctor's explanation speed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その希望も伝えます。今お話しになった内容を、私が記入したので読んでみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that on. I wrote what you told me; please read it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 読みました。場所と始まった日は合っていますので、この内容でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記入された場所と開始日が正しいと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I read it. The location and start date are correct, so please use this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the written location and onset date are correct. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この問診票を医師に渡します。それでは、待合室でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will give this to the doctor. Please wait in the waiting room.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような連絡が届きましたか。携帯の画面を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What contact arrived? Could I see your phone screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 使った覚えのない動画サイトから、今日中に料金を払うようメッセージが来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見覚えのない動画料金の支払い要求を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A video site I do not remember using sent a demand to pay today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain an unfamiliar video-fee payment demand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつから届いていますか。相手に返信したり、支払ったりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: When did these messages start arriving? Have you replied to the sender or paid them anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝から三通です。返信も支払いもしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受信時期と通数を伝え返信も支払いもしていないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Three messages since this morning. Neither replied nor paid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give receipt time and count, and say no reply or payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最初のメッセージを開いていただけますか。本文と送信元を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Open the first message, please. We will check text and sender.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。画面の写真だけでなく、元のメッセージも残したほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最初の画面を示して原文も保存すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here. Should I keep the original message as well as a screen photograph?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the first screen and ask to preserve the original. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、削除せず残してください。書かれているサイトを、ご自身で利用したことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, do not delete it. Have you used that site yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありません。本文のリンクも押していませんが、電話番号が相手に知られているのが心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未利用とリンク未操作を伝え電話番号への不安を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I have not pressed its link either, but I worry they know my phone number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say no use or link action and explain concern about the phone number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 心配な点も記録します。リンクや本文の電話番号を使わず、今ある記録をこちらで確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will note your concern too. Do not use the link or number in the text; let us check the existing records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。三通とも残してあるので、続きも見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三通の記録を順に見せると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. All three are kept, so I will show the rest too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show all three records in order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: また連絡が来たら、記録を残してこちらにご相談ください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: If more arrives, preserve it and consult us here. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱のふたをまだ閉じていらっしゃいませんね。中身を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: The box is not closed yet. May I ask the contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 国内に送る衣類と本です。本が中で動くので、詰め方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 衣類と本を送ると伝え箱の中で本が動くと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Clothes and books for domestic shipping. The books move inside, so I want advice on packing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain domestic clothes and books and moving books in the box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 空いたところに衣類を詰めると動きにくくなります。本は袋などで包んでありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Filling empty areas with clothes limits movement. Are the books wrapped in bags or similar?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、ビニール袋に入れました。シャツを横の隙間に入れればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本の包装を説明してシャツを隙間に入れる方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, plastic bags. Should I put shirts in the gaps beside them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain book wrapping and ask about filling gaps with shirts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうですね、箱を軽く動かしても本がずれないようにしてください。作業は横の台でできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, prevent the books sliding even when the box moves a little. Use the table beside us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 詰め直してから持ってきます。発送後に届いたか調べられる方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 詰め直すと伝え到着状況を調べられる発送方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will repack then bring it back. Is there a method to check afterwards whether it arrived?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will repack and ask for delivery tracking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、追跡番号で配達状況を確認できる方法があります。箱を閉じた後、大きさと重さを測って料金をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, a tracking number lets you check delivery. Once closed, we will measure and weigh the box and advise the fee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その方法を希望します。宛名は箱に直接書くのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追跡できる方法を希望し宛名の書き方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want that method. Do I write the address directly on the box?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request tracking and ask how to address it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの送り状に、お届け先とご依頼主を記入してください。封をする前に、送らないものが紛れていないかも確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Write destination and sender on this shipping form. Before sealing, also check that nothing not meant for sending slipped in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 送り状を書いてから箱を閉じます。詰め直した箱と一緒に持ってきますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 送り状記入と封をして箱を持って戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will fill the form then close the box. I will bring it back with the repacked box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will complete the form, seal and return with the box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、台をお使いください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please use the table. Thank you.
